deviation_note: AMENDED ACCEPTANCE vs plan's '张量全等' wording. The literal bit-exact tensor equality (批推理 vs 逐叶推理 policy/value 张量全等) is NOT achieved at ANY batch size on the real b10c128 19x19 network: PyTorch selects different convolution kernels per batch shape, and float32 differences amplify through the 10-block/128-channel tower (raw policy-logit max abs diff ~5.8e-2, decoded-prior max abs diff ~6.8e-3, value max abs diff ~1.7e-5 on the real network, reproduced under torch.backends.cudnn.deterministic=True / benchmark=False). Amended acceptance (traceable deviation): forward-level equivalence at float32 precision (~1e-3 prior / ~1e-5 value on the real network; ~1e-9 on the toy model) + search determinism under a fixed seed + identical root argmax on the real network. The batching itself is verified sound: batches really reach leaf_batch=16, tail flush correct, virtual-loss claim/release exact, peak GPU memory 0.035 GB << 5 GB, batched search 1.22-1.28x faster than per-leaf.

forward_equivalence_toy.model: toy 5x5 (blocks=1, channels=8, board_size=5) - for reference only

forward_equivalence_real.model: b10c128 19x19 (real network, seed=0, same weights as memory/timing claims)

same_position_same_shape_b1_vs_per_leaf.note: bit-exact ONLY because both paths issue the same (1,17,19,19) shape; this holds for one-off identical-shape forwards, NOT for different batch shapes and NOT across a whole search

toy.note: identical on the toy model only

real.note: b1 batched search is NOT identical to per-leaf search on the production network (call-sequence-dependent kernel selection perturbs priors by ~1e-3-1e-2 within the search, which flips some UCB near-ties). The 'batch_size=1 bit-exact identity' claim holds only in isolation / on the toy model, NOT in a real search. Retained as a seam-exactness check, not as a production equivalence guarantee.

determinism.note: same seed + same evaluator => identical tree; cudnn.deterministic=True / benchmark=False
